purpose: Let a developer recognise useful work, find a suitable tool and reach its access instructions. The invoice is one example of a broad library, not the product category.

direction.basis: Founder-approved direction and accepted companion studies; this brief changes neither their visual values nor their scope.

destinations.purpose: Browse tools by task, then inspect inputs, output, price and access.
A catalogue view for company research with currently available tools.
A catalogue view for document extraction, with actual format limits per tool.
A catalogue view for input validation, with what each check establishes.
MCP/API setup and eligible x402 use; own inputs, price, authentication and payment rules per route.
A captured account call and retrieval, with exact record fields and provenance limits.
Current tool prices, eligibility and charging conditions from canonical live sources.

sections.reader_question: What useful work can my agent do with Strale?
sections.benefit: Add useful external functions to an agent.
sections.headline: Give your agents more useful tools.
sections.body: Research companies, extract document data and validate inputs through one Strale connection.
sections.design_gate: Use the existing labelled illustrative fixture while access is blocked. No completed status, timer, receipt or live badge.
sections.publication_gate: Qualify the synthetic call and displayed fields, selected atmosphere rights, final copy and destination. A captured example must remain dated/labelled and must not imply a request runs on page load.

sections.reader_question: Does the library cover the kind of work I need?
sections.benefit: Find relevant tools across different tasks.
sections.headline: Find a tool for the next step.

choices.headline: Research companies
choices.body: Look up company details from registry data.

choices.headline: Extract document data
choices.body: Turn invoice images into fields your agent can use.

choices.headline: Check inputs
choices.body: Check email format, mail records and disposable domains.

sections.design_gate: Three comparable text choices form one compact discovery unit. No result previews, atmosphere, decorative category icons or repeated primary buttons.
sections.publication_gate: Check current availability and category destinations. These are editorial examples, not a popularity ranking or exhaustive catalogue; manifest existence alone does not establish live availability. Do not copy the invoice manifest's unqualified PDF claim.

sections.reader_question: Why use Strale instead of connecting each provider myself?
sections.benefit: Reuse the Strale access path when adding tools.
sections.headline: Add tools without another provider integration.
sections.body: Use the same Strale connection for research, extraction and validation.
sections.design_gate: Explain shared access with one agent-to-Strale path branching to three named tasks. Keep it a conceptual diagram, not an execution trace.
sections.publication_gate: No hours-saved figure, universal schema or all-routes parity claim. Access guide must explain tool-specific inputs and eligible routes.

sections.reader_question: Can I look back at the result of a call?
sections.benefit: Inspect a completed Strale call made with an API key.
sections.headline: Look back at the result.
sections.body: Retrieve the result and source information from a call made with your API key.
sections.design_gate: Outline only until successful own-transaction retrieval. Do not render invented product fields or a fictional dashboard.
sections.publication_gate: Exclude the whole section unless both execution and retrieval succeed and the exact displayed fields support this wording. No x402 parity, complete agent trace, field citations or internal-receipt claims.

sections.benefit: Choose a useful first tool with its requirements visible.
sections.headline: Choose your first tool.
sections.body: Find the inputs, outputs and price before you make a call.
sections.design_gate: Use accepted direct light text and light action on Dusk. No inner card, product window or new illustration.
sections.publication_gate: Actual catalogue must disclose the named information and reach a supported first-call path. No sign-in control, invented free tier or hardcoded price.

illustrations.job: Show one readable invoice image becoming three useful fields.
illustrations.narrow: Keep the request and the same three result rows in reading order. Remove decorative space, never required labels or legibility.
illustrations.alt: Illustrative invoice from Example Studio, showing supplier, invoice number INV-1042 and total EUR 480.00 as example fields.
illustrations.motion: Static first. If later animated, reveal the same information without implying measured speed; provide the complete static equivalent.

illustrations.job: Let readers recognise three different jobs at a glance.
illustrations.narrow: Keep all three text links visible in one column; no carousel.
illustrations.alt: Use semantic linked text; no duplicate image alternative.

illustrations.job: Make one shared access path understandable without a schema or protocol lesson.
illustrations.master_plan: Use the registered desktop and narrow masters from the illustration extension. Light and inverse versions preserve the same relationship and retained logo geometry. Final page composition and production adoption remain separate.
illustrations.narrow: One vertical path from Your agent through Strale, then three readable task labels; no fake sequence of tool calls.
illustrations.alt: Your agent connects to Strale to access tools for research, extraction and validation.
illustrations.motion: No animated traffic or concurrent completion states. The diagram explains access, not a captured run.

illustrations.job: Show what the customer can retrieve for the exact demonstrated account call.
illustrations.master_plan: Create only after retrieval evidence. Select at most three useful rows from the actual response and link full detail. Keep private account data out of the export.
illustrations.narrow: One flat reading surface, with the same route qualifier and essential fields as desktop.
illustrations.alt: Write from the retrieved response; no placeholder claim of a completed run.

illustrations.job: Make the next action clear with a deliberate change of tone.
illustrations.narrow: Use the existing dark direct-text recipe and readable action order.
illustrations.alt: Decorative gradient; the heading and actions remain semantic text.
